nodes.label: Note Detail View - Notas de caso (Case Notes) for Distribuidora Nexo Comercial S.A.P.I. de C.V.
nodes.author: toledolaw
nodes.description: UI screenshot of a case note detail page in the Captio legal case management app (Spanish). Shows a note titled 'Notas de la primera reunión con cliente' (Notes from the first client meeting) for case #4 - Distribuidora Nexo Comercial S.A.P.I. de C.V., categorized as Negocios/contrato. The note content reads that the client clarified exact meeting dates with the counterparty and showed contracts that need careful review. The detail view shows two relationship panels: 'PERTENECE A (NOTAS PADRE)' showing the note is independent with no parent notes, and 'NOTAS QUE DEPENDEN DE ESTA' showing no dependent notes. Navigation breadcrumbs include back-to-Cases and back-to-Notes buttons, plus a delete note button. User is logged in as 'toledolaw'.
